title: Proceedings to review.
bodyText: The action of the board of agriculture and biosecurity in refusing to grant or renew a license, or in revoking or suspending a license, or in conditioning or limiting the granting or renewal of a license, may be reviewed in the manner provided by chapter 91.
bodyHtml: §157-25  Proceedings to review.  The action of the board of agriculture and biosecurity in refusing to grant or renew a license, or in revoking or suspending a license, or in conditioning or limiting the granting or renewal of a license, may be reviewed in the manner provided by chapter 91. [L 1967, c 260, §16; HRS §157-25; am L 2025, c 236, §18]
